## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `7274e5e9fa43fa96dcfc50bb1107e3dbce543880`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the whole diff of #36789, `git diff e0f0e9f7da7355b84da76e13821ba18a082eb9ec 7274e5e9fa43fa96dcfc50bb1107e3dbce543880` (27 files, 4 commits). Contract face (the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration): `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hans,zh-Hant}.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`, `.changeset/36758-app-menu-design-layout-and-studio.md`. Files in the diff that consume it: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/{SidebarAppMenu,designMode,DesignModeBar,ShellPageActions,ConsoleLayout}.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppNoAccessEmptyState.tsx`, the four `layout/__tests__` suites (`SidebarAppMenu-36112`, `designMode-36362`, `DesignModeMenu-36363`, `UnifiedSidebar.hiddenCollapse-35062`), `ui/packages/app-shell/README.md`, `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`. Cited and read only: `AppHeader.tsx` (the Studio pencil's `topbar.editApp`), `utils/appRoute.ts` (`appStudioRoutePath`, `appStudioDesignPath`), `context/NavigationContext.tsx`, `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` (the one mount), `ui/packages/{i18n,app-shell}/package.json`, `.changeset/config.json`, the i18n CHANGELOG entry 38bb373 that added `topbar.editApp`, AGENTS.md's changeset rule. Also searched `content/`, `skills/`, `docs/qa/`, `packages/qa/` and the sibling checkouts hotcrm, cloud and docs.objectos.ai for the old door wording and the moved test id.
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

Everything below comes from reading the diff and the tree at the head. Nothing was run. The PR body and card #36758 (with the maintainer's 15:59Z ruling and wording) were read for context. The head matches the PR's `head.sha`; it did not move.

### ① Derived judgments

**The widening declaration is right and complete.**
- Two keys are added under `topbar` in all eleven shipped packs (`ar`, `de`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, `ja`, `ko`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`): `designLayout` and `viewInStudio`. `@object-ui/i18n` publishes the packs through its `./locales` and `./locales/*` exports, so this is a widening of a published surface, and nothing else is added.
- No key is removed or renamed. `useAppStudioEntry` was already exported from `ShellPageActions.tsx` on the base, and `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so the new import inside the package is not a public export. No prop changes.
- The other pack edits change words, not keys or meanings: `designMode.title`, `designMode.leaveUnsaved`, `designMode.menu.newItemSavesAll` (ja, ko, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant), the report builder's `addsToMenu` (zh-Hans, zh-Hant), `empty.appMenuEmptyDescription` (all packs), and Studio's `engine.studio.data.appMenu.failed` / `failedNoApp` (en, zh). Each still names the same thing (the design mode). After the edit no pack names the mode by its old word (checked per pack for 设计模式 / 設計模式 / Design mode / Designmodus / modo de diseño / mode conception / デザインモード / 디자인 모드 / modo de design / режим дизайна / وضع التصميم), and no `defaultValue` in `ui/packages` still says "design mode".

**`topbar.editApp`: its words are unchanged, and it now names only the Studio entry.** It was added in 38bb373 for `AppHeader`'s Studio pencil, which still reads it. #36485 also used it for the sidebar's design-mode door, so on the base one key named two different doors. The PR gives the door its own key (`topbar.designLayout`), so `topbar.editApp` again names Studio wherever it is drawn. Someone reading the key's value sees no change. A consumer that overrides the key's text sees that override move from the design-mode row to the Studio row. The changeset says so ("`topbar.editApp` keeps its words and now names the Studio entry wherever it is drawn").

**Every pack has both new keys, and the translations are reasonable.** zh-Hans 设计布局 / 在 Studio 中查看, and zh-Hant 設計佈局 / 在 Studio 中檢視, match the ruling's wording. en is "Design layout" / "View in Studio". de, fr, es, pt-BR, ja, ko, ar and ru are idiomatic or close to it. ru's 「Открыть в Studio」 follows that pack's existing `openAppInStudio`. In every pack `designLayout` equals `designMode.title`, and the new words-block test pins that. The eight non-Chinese, non-English packs have not been reviewed by a native speaker, and the PR says so (N2).

**The de quote-pairing count (133 → 134) is explained.** The one new „…“ pair is „Layout gestalten“ in de `empty.appMenuEmptyDescription`. The other de edits are plain-quoted JS strings with no „“. Both the `okSpans` pin and the `{open, close, rdq}` pin move by exactly one, and `close === open + rdq` still holds.

**The menu does what the card and the ruling ask.**
- 「设计布局」: `DesignLayoutItem` uses `useEnterDesignMode`, whose body is unchanged. Who sees it is unchanged: a workspace admin holding `manage_metadata`, on an app whose package Studio lists, with the mode not already on. A read-only package under an org wall shows the row only to a platform admin.
- 「编辑应用」 / 「在 Studio 中查看」: `StudioAppItem` gets its target and posture from `useAppStudioEntry(true, activeAppName)`, the same code the top bar's pencil reads. On an object route it goes to `/studio/<pkg>/data?surface=object:<name>`, and on a dashboard route to `…/interfaces?surface=dashboard:<name>` (both pinned). Who sees it is decided by `useStudioEntryGate`, the same predicate as the design door. No new gate is added.
- Rows appear in this order: list, rule, 设计布局, Studio row, 添加应用, in one group (pinned).
- The design-mode bar's title is now 「设计布局」 (pinned in `designMode-36362`).

**Nobody loses an entry.** Everyone who had the old door has 「设计布局」 under the same condition. The Studio row is new. A phone had neither door before and has neither now, because the sidebar's head is drawn only from 768 px up. The Studio row also shows while the mode is on, as the app switcher's row does. With changes staged, leaving for `/studio` passes the mode's `registerUnsavedEdits` guard (`keeps` = page of this app only).

**Docs.** `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` and the app-shell README are updated. `skills/`, `docs/qa/` and `packages/qa/` had no references to the old door. The other "design mode" hits in `content/docs` are the dashboard's own design mode, not this one.

### ② Semver level

- `patch` on `@object-ui/i18n` (published) and `@object-ui/app-shell` (private). This follows AGENTS.md's changeset rule: a widening that is not a protocol change ships `patch`, and only a `Metadata-protocol` kind other than `none` forces `minor`.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is right. Language-pack keys are not something a metadata author writes: no spec key, accepted value or metadata type moves.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right, and it appears at the start of a line in both the PR body and the changeset. No `major`: nothing is removed, and no text a consumer reads by key changes in a way that breaks it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Pins fail without the fix, by reading.** The Studio-row describe block (both targets, the eye posture, the gate that does not depend on the mode, and the member, non-author and Setup controls) cannot pass on the base, which has no Studio row. Neither can the words block, the `sidebar-app-menu-design-layout` / `lucide-pencil-ruler` door assertions, the renamed bar region, the renamed leave prompt, or the de count of 134.
- **No test was weakened.** The edits to the existing suites rename the expected words and the test id. The "no Studio entry" control is narrowed to a member and extended to also refuse 「Edit app」 and 「View in Studio」.
- **Downstream apps that rely on the old key text.** `topbar.editApp`'s text is unchanged in every pack, so nothing that reads it by key breaks. What changes is the value of `designMode.title` and the related strings, all text a consumer renders rather than matches on. The data-test id `sidebar-app-menu-edit-app` now sits on the Studio row, and the design door is `sidebar-app-menu-design-layout`. There are no other users of the id in this repo, hotcrm, cloud or docs.objectos.ai (N1).
- **SQL / id materialization.** Not touched; client-only change.
- **Author.** PR `user.login` is `os-warren`, not `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment

This PR's surfaces are the `Clause-②: yes` declaration alone. They include no published schema, governed rule text or narrowing, so ④ is not required. For the record:
- Restoring `topbar.editApp` to its first meaning (the Studio entry) and adding a key for the door is better than renaming the key as the card's body proposed. A rename would have mislabelled `AppHeader`'s Studio pencil.
- Taking the Studio row's target from `useAppStudioEntry` keeps the three Studio doors in agreement: the top bar's pencil, the app switcher's row and this row.

Findings:

- **N1:** The test id `sidebar-app-menu-edit-app` changed meaning: it was the design-mode door and is now the Studio row. Nothing outside this repo's own suites uses it, but the changeset does not mention it. An out-of-tree e2e that clicked it to enter design mode would now land in Studio instead of failing loudly.
- **N2:** The ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR and ru wording has not been reviewed by a native speaker, and the PR says so. es 「Diseñar la disposición」 is the stiffest of these. en 「Leave Design layout?」 capitalises a common noun mid-sentence because it treats the door's name as a proper noun. That reads unusually but is deliberate.
- **N3:** `SidebarAppMenu` now imports `useAppStudioEntry` from `ShellPageActions.tsx`, a component module. That pulls `HelpMenu` and `AssistantTopBarButton` into the sidebar's import graph. `ShellPageActions` also had to import `appStudioRoutePath` straight from `utils/appRoute.js` to get around the sidebar suites' partial stub of the barrel. Moving the hook to `hooks/` would remove both.
- **N4:** The PR body says leaving for Studio with staged changes asks first. That relies on the existing `registerUnsavedEdits` guard, which reads correctly, but no test in this diff pins it for the new Studio row.

**VERDICT: PASS**
